item.title: Romeo Santos Sues Accounting Firm for Malpractice Over Financial Mistakes He Says Cost Him Millions
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music news update. We've got a story that's trending on Billboard, and it's a big one. Latin superstar Romeo Santos is taking his accounting firm to court, claiming they've left him with a huge tax bill and cost him millions of dollars in damages. Here's what's happening."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to the lawsuit, Santos hired the firm back in 2016, trusting them to manage his finances as a global touring and recording artist. But he says the firm, BDO USA, failed to deliver, botching his taxes, filing incorrect returns, and even failing to claim credits on foreign taxes already withheld from his royalties."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This isn't the first time BDO has been in trouble with a music star. Back in 2022, Fat Joe filed a lawsuit claiming the firm had stolen millions of dollars from him. That case settled in 2024, but it's clear that Santos isn't the only one who's had issues with BDO."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, what's Santos looking for? He's claiming at least $2.3 million in damages, stemming from tax penalties and interest. He says BDO's failures have cost him millions, and he's not going to let it slide. We'll be keeping an eye on this story as it develops."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for this week's music news update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time."
